label: Interhour of the Sixth Hour
description: The Interhour of the Sixth Hour (Mezhduchasiye) is a brief interstitial office appended to its Hour in monastic practice. CORRECTED 2026-09-26, Horologion audit fix pass (Findings IH1-IH3): the psalms were wrong, the troparia were wrongly modeled as Menaion-dependent (this office's troparia are a fixed, hour-specific triad per UNABHOR1997), and roughly half of the office's real closing content was missing outright. Rebuilt against UNABHOR1997 (Rassaphor-monk Laurence, The Unabbreviated Horologion, Holy Trinity Monastery, 1997) in full.

sections.label: Fixed Psalmody
sections.notes: The Interhour of the Sixth Hour appoints Psalms 55, 56, 69 (LXX). CORRECTED 2026-09-26, Horologion audit fix pass (Finding IH1): the psalms previously listed here did not match UNABHOR1997.

Amen.
